scripts.optimize:images: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Path src/assets/images/original -Recurse -Include *.jpg, *.png | ForEach-Object { $output = $_.FullName -replace '\.[^.]+$','.webp'; npx sharp-cli -i $_.FullName -o $output -f webp -q 80 }"
scripts.build: npm run optimize:images && npm run build:css && npm run build:11ty
